content: Rohan Ahuja called about a delayed refund for his cancelled home policy HP-001234. He was promised a 3‑5 business‑day turnaround, but a week had passed. Agent Sunita Agarwal apologized, identified a processing issue, escalated it, and assured the refund would arrive within two business days. She also confirmed the policy was cancelled effective the previous week and that no further bills will be issued. The customer thanked her and ended the call.

action_items: Refund to be issued within the next 2 business days
Policy HP-001234 confirmed cancelled effective last week
No further billing for the cancelled policy
